name: barbell paused sumo deadlift
description: Sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor to build strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
